name: start_session
description: Start a gaming or emulation session for a console system. Use when the user says they are about to play, launch, or start a game on a system.

name: set_performance_profile
description: Set the device CPU and GPU clock profile. max for heavy 3D emulation, stock for normal use, powersave for maximum battery life.

name: set_fan_mode
description: Set the cooling fan mode. off is silent, auto follows temperature, cool runs the fan gently, max runs it at full speed for long heavy sessions.

name: set_screen_timeout
description: Change how long the screen stays on before sleeping, in milliseconds. Use for reading, watching, or when the screen turns off too quickly.

name: note
description: Record a remark, preference, or observation for later review. Does not change any device setting.
